deployments_detail.use: AI for document processing in customs and logistics operations - extracting/reading data from shipping and customs documents to reduce manual data entry and repetitive work. Company states it has leveraged AI for document processing 'for years' and is expanding to global self-service capabilities.
AI used to increase efficiency in procuring and booking air and ocean freight capacity, improving the company's ability to secure and allocate carrier capacity.

Enhanced Container Tracking - a predictive-analytics engine using a state-of-the-art algorithm to generate baseline predictive ETAs on schedules, transit times and ETAs for all vessels/trade lanes from historical data, continuously refreshed with real-time carrier/terminal feeds. Delivered via the EXP.O NOW platform and integrated across NVOCC, Customs, Order and Delivery Management.

Expeditors Carrier Allocation - a cloud-based collaboration platform that forecasts, plans and connects shippers and forwarders with ocean carriers to optimize product flow and capacity planning; provides forecasting-accuracy analytics. Pioneered with Walmart and released as an industry solution.

AI-enabled customs compliance tooling within the Expeditors Customs Product - automated document validation and AI-enabled tools that reduce manual steps, accelerate clearance and strengthen regulatory adherence; positioned to help reduce customs entry times while retaining licensed-broker oversight.

Machine learning applied across the supply chain for forecast accuracy and insight generation ('insight-powered supply chains') - using ML on data continually captured through business flows to improve forecasting and surface predictive insights for customers.
AI vision and strategic approach for supply chain logistics with current capabilities and applications
Innovation and technology approach including AI
AI in logistics navigation and organizational AI journey assessment
Icertis Contract Intelligence AI (via CloudMoyo) for global operations; AI-driven supply-chain systems

AI-guided collaborative warehouse robots ('Chuck' by 6 River Systems) that direct workers on the most efficient picking paths and enable multi-order fulfillment, deployed in Expeditors' distribution/fulfillment operations to reduce assembly times and improve accuracy. [6 River Systems (Chuck)]
deployments_detail.value: increased outbound speed by 100% (North Coast Medical case study)

deployments_detail.use: Generative AI agents in production - centrally developed agents plus employee-built custom agents used across the global organization to automate repetitive work and boost productivity, overlaid on Expeditors' unified data systems.
